quests.name: Nautical Nuisance
quests.description: Barnacles are starting to form on the Liberator's hull, but Rusty's joints are acting up too much to dive down and scrape them off. He'd appreciate if you can help out because given time they can cause quite a bit of trouble.

quests.name: <color=mythical>Sparks</color>
quests.description: While flying South over Jhavesk <color=uncommon>Ensign Cliff's</color> squad's helicopter took several electric shocks from a giant sparking zombie. If you're brave enough he's sure it'd be appreciated to kill it before it can cause more trouble.

quests.name: <color=mythical>Scorched Earth</color>
quests.description: Recently Norbert was helping out on a scavenging mission to Novosibirsk when they ran into a gigantic "firebreathing" zombie. Unfortunately this means they can't clear it out for supplies until the zombie is slain.

quests.name: <color=mythical>Aftershock</color>
quests.description: During Peter's escape from Yekaterinburg he barely avoided a giant zombie that pounced from the air, slamming into the ground causing "miniature earthquakes". He hasn't been able to get it out of his mind and would really appreciate knowing it had been dealt with.

quests.name: On Air
quests.description: <color=legendary>Commander Laurence</color> wants to get the Russian radio towers working again to broadcast to any survivors still out there. You'll need a toolkit which he says Natalie down in engineering can provide.

quests.name: The One That Got Away
quests.description: If you happen to catch Wallace's nemesis – the <color=legendary>Giant Squid</color> – he'd love to see it! Keep in mind the chances are quite slim, it's very rare.

quests.name: Getting the Word Out
quests.description: For survivors without radios <color=legendary>Commander Laurence</color> plans to put up posters with directions to the Liberator. He suggests placing them in each town/city's police station.

quests.name: The Squeaky Motor Gets the Grease
quests.description: The ship's engine has been rattling quite a bit recently, but Natalie doesn't have the resources spare to fix it up. If you can find them for her while looting she'll take care of it!

quests.name: Smuggler's Cove
quests.description: If you think it's worth checking out <color=epic>Chief Brian</color> has given you permission to investigate the smuggling. He thinks if there is any base to it there'd be traces of a shipment somewhere along the coastline.

quests.name: Coldcase
quests.description: <color=epic>Chief Brian</color> suggests starting with Darren, Harry's bunkmate, on the bridge. It might also be worth searching through Harry's stuff, and Natalie might have seen something, and Roman might have overheard something... Suffice it to say he has a lot of suggestions.

quests.name: The Conspiracy's Conclusion
quests.description: <color=epic>Major Len</color> just received a transmission from the smugglers that seems to have originated from Silo 22 in the far North, but he suspects they actually used it as a relay station. If that's correct there should be a log in the command center which might reveal who sent it, and from where.

quests.name: Memoir
quests.description: Gwen accidentally lost her wedding ring overboard. She'd really appreciate if you can bring it back to remember her husband by.

quests.name: Top Gun
quests.description: Before taking to the skies you'll need a <color=rare>Fighter Pilot Outfit</color> and a replacement Jet Compressor. Andy thinks you can salvage a Compressor from the wreckage of the nuclear submarine West of the Liberator and retrofit it for the Jet.

quests.name: The Secret Snack
quests.description: <color=epic>Chief Brian</color> is craving for a few doughnuts, but doesn't want to be seen to fit the police stereotype. He wants this kept on the down-low, you know hush hush.

quests.name: Research Recovery
quests.description: As a side project Dr. Swanson is researching the virus and potential for a cure. The remains of a <color=legendary>Scorpion-7</color> cargo plane were spotted in the very far North, and she suspects that research capsules containing samples, notes, DNA, etc were strewn from the plane into the deadzone during the crash.

quests.name: The Hunt for Jet Fuel
quests.description: <color=rare>Lieutenant Oswald</color> is willing to give you a try scouting out a location, in this case an airport North-East of Moscow. This usually involves clearing out quite a few zombies, and then analyzing the environment to prepare a report determining which areas are worth securing.

quests.name: Mass Production
quests.description: Russia has many warehouses filled with old WWII and Cold War machinery, but this one in the North-West is of particular note. Satellite images from 6 years ago differ from newer data suggesting it was brought back into use as a factory, and <color=rare>Lieutenant Oswald</color> thinks it might have been producing new armored vehicles.

quests.name: The Wolf's Den
quests.description: Volk, the Russian word for wolf. <color=rare>Lieutenant Oswald</color> wants you to infiltrate what is essentially Russia's largest military base in the far North-West, easy right?

quests.name: First Contact
quests.description: This isn't the first time the <color=legendary>Coalition</color>'s been to Russia. Back in the organization's infancy a primarily Russian task force seized an offshore oil rig in the South-West as a proxy pending backup to reclaim the mainland, but something went wrong. <color=rare>Lieutenant Oswald</color> needs you to find out what.

quests.name: W.M.D.
quests.description: In the far North is a secret underground nuclear missile silo which has supposedly detonated, but aside from the radiation there's no evidence of explosive damage. <color=rare>Lieutenant Oswald</color> needs you to verify that the warhead is completely spent and can't be used again.

quests.name: The Great Escape
quests.description: T.Rickster is supposedly wrongly imprisoned, but insists you don't ask the security team about him. He's given you a blueprint for his favourite kind of cake and would really appreciate if you can bake it for him. He can't give you much now, but says he'll pay you back later.

quests.name: The Ultimate Fishing Rod
quests.description: Wallace needs a reinforced fishing rod to catch the illusive giant squid. He's given you a blueprint to craft it from a normal fishing rod.

quests.name: Mysterious Papertrail
quests.description: <color=legendary>Commander Laurence</color> needs an important note delivered to Rusty. He'd appreciate if you didn't say who it's from.

quests.name: Gingerbread Army
quests.description: Try out Sous-Chef Roman's new festive recipe. Combine flour, eggs and chocolate and bake in an oven for a flavourful surprise.

quests.name: Festive Cheer
quests.description: Use the Saw to harvest Candy Cane Fragments and create some decorations.

quests.name: Christmas Eve
quests.description: Apparently there have been presents scattered somewhere in Moscow, go and check it out!

quests.name: Suspicious Snowballs
quests.description: Some mysterious frozen water with explosive properites has started accumulating on the Liberator's deck. Harvest some samples for Doc Ernie to investigate.
